mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_channel_binding ucb WHERE ucb.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ucb.channel_type, ucb.created_at DESC
mapper.sql: (user_id, channel_type, workspace_id, external_user_id, display_address, access_token_enc, refresh_token_enc, token_expires_at, status, last_verified_at, created_at, updated_at)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_channel_binding VALUES ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uk_user_channel DO UPDATE SET access_token_enc = EXCLUDED.access_token_enc, refresh_token_enc = EXCLUDED.refresh_token_enc, token_expires_at = EXCLUDED.token_expires_at, status = EXCLUDED.status, last_verified_at = EXCLUDED.last_verified_at, updated_at = #{now}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO user_channel_binding t USING (SELECT #{userId} AS u, #{channelType} AS c, CAST(#{workspaceId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS NUMBER(19)) AS w FROM DUAL) s ON (t.user_id = s.u AND t.channel_type = s.c AND t.workspace_id = s.w) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.access_token_enc = #{accessTokenEnc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.refresh_token_enc = #{refreshTokenEnc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.token_expires_at = #{tokenExpiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, t.status = #{status}, t.last_verified_at = #{lastVerifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, t.updated_at = #{now} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT VALUES
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_channel_binding ucb JOIN slack_workspace sw ON sw.id = ucb.workspace_id WHERE sw.team_id = #{teamId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ucb.channel_type = 'SLACK' AND ucb.external_user_id = #{externalUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ucb.status = 'ACTIVE'
